Recorded claim:
Before deleting refs/tags, save reference state to `.git/release-cleanup-refs.json`; inspect tag reachability, delete only release tags, then run `git -c gc.reflogExpire=never -c gc.reflogExpireUnreachable=never gc --prune=now`. Verify retained refs/HEAD against the manifest and query each former release tip. [Task 1]
